plugins.name: claude-obsidian
plugins.description: Local-first Agent Skills package and Claude Code plugin for source-cited Obsidian knowledge bases. Provides explicit vault initialization and adoption, recoverable operation transactions, deterministic lint and retrieval, provenance ledgers, offline-first capture foundations, and optional methodology modes (LYT / PARA / Zettelkasten / Generic). User vaults stay outside the plugin cache; network and destructive actions require explicit consent. This fork adds Open Knowledge Format v0.1 conformance: every generated note carries a non-empty `type` (OKF spec section 9) plus the recommended `title`, `description`, and `timestamp`, so a vault is readable by any OKF consumer and not only by this plugin.
